{{Quote|The baron administrator sent me to a suite at the Grand Bespin Hotel. He told me to bring my finest work, fit for royalty. I thought he was only being dramatic.|Neshee to [[Jailyn Cirri]]|<ref name="Clouds">{{StoryCite|story=Into the Clouds|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}}</ref>}}
The '''Grand Bespin Hotel''' was a [[hotel]]<ref name="Clouds" /> located on the [[Tibanna]] [[mining]] colony of [[Cloud City]].<ref name="Episode 5" /> It was notable for its [[Color|white]] awchways.<ref name="Clouds" /> After fleeing [[Hoth]] with [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]],<ref name="Episode 5" /> [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]<ref name="Fake">{{StoryCite|story=Fake It Till You Make It|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}}</ref> stayed in a suite at the hotel<ref name="Clouds" /> while the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' was being repaired.<ref name="Episode 5" /> [[Baron Administrator|Baron administrator]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] sent the stylist [[Neshee]] to<ref name="Clouds" /> the princess'<ref name="Fake" /> suite, telling him to bring his finest work, fit for royalty. Neshee brought a [[cloak]] in radiant tones of red and orange and was surprised to discover that the garment was for an actual princess.<ref name="Clouds" /> Later, Solo came to<ref name="Episode 5" /> Leia's<ref name="Fake" /> suite<ref name="Clouds" /> to inform her that the ''Falcon''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s repairs were almost finished. Shortly afterward, Chewbacca came there with the body parts of [[C-3PO]], who, unbeknownst to them, had been blasted apart by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s. Calrissian then greeted them in the apartment and asked them to join him for refreshments, before leading them to the<ref name="Episode 5" /> [[Rinetta dining room]].<ref name="Fake" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Grand Bespin Hotel originates in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] roleplaying supplement ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', published in [[1993]]. It was named "Bespin Grand Hotel" in the book,<ref name="Guide">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> but was later given the alternate name "Grand Bespin Hotel" in ''[[Cloud Cover]]'', a ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' article published in [[Star Wars Gamer 3|''Star Wars Gamer'' 3]] in [[2001]].<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|3|Cloud Cover}}</ref> It was brought into [[canon]] in the short story "[[Into the Clouds]]," published in the [[2020]] anthology book ''[[From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back]]''. The short story established the hotel as the location where Leia Organa was staying in Cloud City during the events of the film {{Film|5}}.<ref name="Clouds" />
